name: CoordAtt

x.description: input feature map (N, C, H, W)

reduction.description: channel reduction factor for intermediate projection; default 32

output.description: gated output feature map (N, C, H, W)

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, inp=None, oup=None, reduction=32):
    if reduction is None:
        reduction = 32
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    identity = x
    n, c, h, w = x.shape
    if inp is None:
        inp = c
    if oup is None:
        oup = c
    inp = c
    oup = c
    mip = max(8, inp // reduction)

    conv1 = nn.Conv2d(inp, mip, 1, 1, 0).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(mip).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv_h = nn.Conv2d(mip, oup, 1, 1, 0).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv_w = nn.Conv2d(mip, oup, 1, 1, 0).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    x_h = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, (None, 1))
    x_w = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, (1, None)).permute(0, 1, 3, 2)

    y = torch.cat([x_h, x_w], dim=2)
    y = conv1(y)
    y = bn1(y)
    y = y * (F.relu6(y + 3) / 6)

    x_h, x_w = torch.split(y, [h, w], dim=2)
    x_w = x_w.permute(0, 1, 3, 2)

    a_h = torch.sigmoid(conv_h(x_h))
    a_w = torch.sigmoid(conv_w(x_w))

    return identity * a_w * a_h
description: Coordinate Attention that embeds positional information via adaptive pooling and 1x1 convolutions with h-swish and sigmoid gating.
